proofReview.oneTurnNecessity: If left endpoints cross a column threshold upward and later downward, take a contiguous run with L>c bracketed by rows with L<=c. Neighbor overlap forces each bracket's R>c, so columnc is selected on both sides and absent in the run: a hole. The reflected argument gives the right-endpoint peak condition.
